# Oli — AI Agronomist
# https://codex-ask-oli-app.vercel.app

## What is Oli?
Oli is an AI-powered agronomist web application for farmers worldwide. It works with every crop — olives, vines, citrus, vegetables, fruit trees, herbs, cereals, and more. It provides instant crop disease diagnosis from photos, personalized treatment recommendations (both organic and chemical), and a 13-day follow-up system to track intervention outcomes.

## Key Capabilities
- **Photo Diagnosis**: Upload a photo of a sick plant and get an instant AI diagnosis identifying the disease, pest, or nutrient deficiency
- **Treatment Plans**: Every diagnosis includes both organic and chemical treatment options with exact product names, dosages, and application methods
- **VIO Loop (Verified Intervention Outcome)**: After logging a treatment, Oli follows up in 13 days to ask if the treatment worked, building a data flywheel
- **Voice Input**: Speak to Oli in your language — ideal for farmers with dirty hands in the field
- **Intervention History**: Complete log of all diagnoses and treatments, searchable and exportable
- **Every Crop**: Works with every crop — olives, vines, citrus, tomatoes, peppers, cucumbers, potatoes, stone fruits, herbs, cereals, and 450+ identifiable diseases

## Common Diseases Identified
- Olive: Cycloconium, olive fly, peacock spot, verticillium wilt
- Vine: Downy mildew, powdery mildew, botrytis
- Citrus: Citrus canker, sooty mold, scale insects, tristeza
- Tomato: Late blight, early blight, fusarium wilt, blossom end rot
- General: Aphids, spider mites, whitefly, nitrogen/phosphorus/potassium deficiency

## Languages
English and Greek (more coming soon)

## Pricing
- Free: 20 questions per month, no credit card required
- Pro: Unlimited questions (subscription)

## Technology
- AI: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash with structured JSON responses
- Stack: React, Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage), Vercel
- Data: EU-hosted (Frankfurt), GDPR compliant, end-to-end encrypted
